name: AssetSonar
summary: AssetSonar by EZO prices IT asset management per asset. ITAM costs $0.75 per asset a month and $1.08 with the service desk included, both billed annually, with volume discounts. Advanced software asset management is a $0.42 add-on per asset a month. Packages start at 100 assets.

facts.text: AssetSonar finds assets through an agent for Windows, macOS and Linux, agentless network scans and MDM integrations.
EZO says it maintains SOC 2 Type 2 compliance, ISO/IEC 27001 certification and CSA STAR Level 1 registration.
The software page lists renewal alerts and a central renewal page for license dates, and the hardware page lists alerts for warranty expirations.
Upgrades made before the annual term ends are prorated, and EU hosting is arranged during purchase.
